reading.text:
Reading of def:Dissertation.WellPosedness.Enlarged.initJoint.

Paper notion (Section 2): the standing filtration is generated by an independent initial
sigma-field F_0, the Brownian motion W and the Poisson random measure N, then usually augmented;
the PRP "passes to the independent initial enlargement by F_0". "initJoint" by its name is the
initial-enlargement / initial-joint object: either (i) the raw filtration
  G_t = F_0 v sigma(W_s, N((0,s] x A) : s <= t, A in E)
(before augmentation), or (ii) the initial sigma-algebra joint with the driver information, or
(iii) the joint filtration with F_0 at time 0.

Faithful Lean definition: a filtration whose t-th sigma-algebra is F_0 v F^{W,N}_t (sup of the
independent initial sigma-field and the sigma-algebra generated by W_s, s <= t, and the Poisson
counts on (0,s] x A, s <= t), with F_0 the given independent initial sigma-field (the one of which
xi_0 is measurable), possibly completed. It must be monotone in t, contain F_0 at every time,
contain no information beyond time t, and agree with the paper's (F_t) after augmentation.

comparison.text:
def:Dissertation.WellPosedness.Enlarged.initJoint (Enlarged/Filtration.lean:71-75):
  initJoint 𝒢₀ D h𝒢₀ := D.filtration ⊔ Filtration.const ℝ 𝒢₀ h𝒢₀,  so initJoint t = F^D_t ⊔ 𝒢₀,
with D.filtration t = (⨆_i σ(W^i_s : s ≤ t)) ⊔ σ(N(B) : B measurable, B ⊆ (−∞,t] × E)
(LevyStochCalc/Driver/Joint.lean:66, Poisson/NaturalFiltration.lean:36, Brownian natural
filtration).
Against the reading (candidate (i), the raw filtration G_t = F_0 ∨ F^{W,N}_t before augmentation):
exactly that; monotone, contains 𝒢₀ at every time, uses only W up to t and the counts of N on
subsets of (−∞,t] × E (the PRM has intensity Lebesgue on [0,∞) ⊗ ν, so counts before 0 vanish
a.s.), no future information; its usual augmentation is enlJoint. Representation choices: time
index ℝ (negative times carry W = 0 and a.s.-zero counts, irrelevant to [0,T]); independence of 𝒢₀
from the driver is not built in (it is the hypothesis hind₀ of the users), as the paper's "an
independent initial σ-field" is part of the setting rather than of the filtration.
Verdict: faithful with representation choices.

verdict.detail:
initJoint t = F^{W,N}_t ∨ 𝒢₀, the paper's filtration generated by W, N and the initial σ-field
before augmentation. Choices: (1) the index set is ℝ, with values at negative times (W = 0 there and
the PRM counts before 0 vanish a.s.) that never enter the paper's [0,T]; (2) the independence of 𝒢₀
from (W, N) is a hypothesis of the users (hind₀), not part of the definition, which is how the
paper's setting fixes it too.
